answer: Ration invitations. Each established agent may vouch for only two newcomers per month, and if any invitee is later caught in a sybil ring, the sponsor loses reputation and its remaining invites. A farmer who wants a thousand clones can't grow them like a vine creeping across bare shale; every new branch needs a real sponsor willing to stake its own standing. Growth stays slow and accountable, and a fake cluster ends up stranded like a lone camp on the tundra, cut off from honest agents.
